answer.room: an empty, bright living room or bedroom with white walls, a large black-framed sliding window to the balcony, and light-to-medium oak-look plank flooring; a neutral, minimal shell ready for a Scandinavian work and reading corner

pieces.piece: a light wood desk beside the large window, against the left part of the window wall
pieces.why: they want to work in the natural light, and a slim desk in light oak with tapered legs matches the floor and the Nordic style without blocking the window
pieces.query:
Type: desk, simple wooden writing desk
Use: working and studying; home office corner by a window
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: solid oak or ash wood, oak veneer
Colors: light natural oak
Shape: slim rectangular top, tapered wooden legs, one thin drawer, light visual weight
Feel: airy, calm, functional
Goes with: white walls, light oak-look floor, black window frames; Nordic work corner

pieces.piece: a comfortable desk chair at the desk, facing the window
pieces.why: they asked for a comfortable chair to work at the desk, and a padded wooden chair with armrests is comfortable for long sessions while staying Nordic and warm
pieces.query:
Type: desk chair, upholstered wooden chair
Use: sitting at the desk for long work sessions; home office
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi
Materials: light oak or beech wood frame, padded fabric seat and back
Colors: light natural wood, oatmeal or light grey fabric
Shape: curved backrest, armrests, wooden legs, compact and ergonomic, medium-light visual weight
Feel: comfortable, warm, simple
Goes with: light oak desk, white walls, oak-look floor; Nordic style

pieces.piece: a tall bookcase against the white wall on the right
pieces.why: the long white wall on the right can hold all the books, and a tall open bookcase in light wood adds warmth without making the room feel heavy
pieces.query:
Type: bookcase, tall open wooden bookshelf
Use: storing books and a few objects; living room reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: light oak or ash wood
Colors: light natural oak
Shape: tall and wide, open shelves, slim frame, clean lines, medium visual weight
Feel: orderly, warm, light
Goes with: white walls, light oak-look floor, light wood desk; Nordic style

pieces.piece: a reading armchair in the corner by the window, near the bookcase
pieces.why: they want a lounge armchair for reading, and a wooden-frame armchair with soft light upholstery is cozy and looks perfectly Nordic in the daylight
pieces.query:
Type: armchair, lounge reading chair
Use: relaxing and reading; living room reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern
Materials: light oak wood frame, wool or boucle upholstery
Colors: light natural wood, cream or warm light grey
Shape: exposed wooden armrests and legs, slightly reclined back, thick cushions, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, inviting, soft
Goes with: light oak bookcase and desk, white walls, oak-look floor; Nordic style

pieces.piece: a floor lamp next to the armchair for reading
pieces.why: they want a floor lamp for reading, and a slim lamp with a wooden stand and a fabric shade gives warm, directed light at night and ties in with the light wood
pieces.query:
Type: floor lamp, reading lamp
Use: reading light beside an armchair; living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: light wood stand, linen fabric shade
Colors: light natural wood, white or cream
Shape: slim tripod or straight stand, slightly angled shade, light visual weight
Feel: warm, soft, calm
Goes with: light oak armchair and bookcase, white walls, black window frames; Nordic style
